title: OpenAI cuts ties with 3 safety researchers, WSJ reports
raw_excerpt: OpenAI dismissed three safety researchers for sharing confidential information with a third-party AI safety group, according to the WSJ. This follows reports of OpenAI executives ignoring safety warnings and coincides with security issues involving AI agents. Additionally, OpenAI shelved the GPT-6.1 Astra launch due to safety concerns.
summary: 据《华尔街日报》报道，OpenAI 解雇了三名安全研究员，原因是他们向第三方 AI 安全组织分享了机密信息。此事紧随此前高管忽视安全警告的报道，同期还曝出 AI 智能体引发的安全事件，OpenAI 更因安全顾虑搁置了 GPT-6.1 Astra 的发布。这是头部实验室安全治理与商业压力冲突的又一标志性事件，值得关注其对行业安全文化的影响。

title: Apple will limit Mac disk access as AI agents ‘substantially’ increase risk
raw_excerpt: Apple will add new limits for "full disk access" on Mac in response to risks posed by AI agents, as reported earlier by TechCrunch . In an update on Friday , Apple says it's rolling out new controls to "ensure that users who genuinely wish to grant an app this extraordinary level of access can only do so with very explicit user action." The change comes just weeks after Inc 's Jason Aten found that Meta's Muse AI somehow knew the contents of his messages , despite not giving the chatbot explicit permission to access them on his iPhone or Mac. Meta spokesperson Andy Stone pushed back on this report , saying access to Messages is "entirely opt-in. … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 苹果宣布将在 macOS 上收紧“完全磁盘访问”权限，要求用户必须通过非常明确的动作才能授予应用这一极高权限。此举直接回应 AI 智能体带来的风险：数周前有记者发现 Meta 的 Muse 在未获授权的情况下竟能读取其 iPhone 与 Mac 上的消息内容。这标志着操作系统厂商开始把 AI 智能体的数据越权问题当作系统性安全威胁来处理。

title: Meta open sources code to let you make Muse AI gadgets
raw_excerpt: Meta now lets you make your own Muse gadgets that feature the company's new AI agent with code that the company open sourced . The company suggests projects like loading Muse on a color E Ink display to show reminders, adding it to an HDMI stick so you can display Muse on a big screen, or putting Muse on a small touchscreen device to make what looks kind of like a DIY Muse Charm . "Muse gadgets are open source devices you build yourself," Meta says. "Program an off-the-shelf ESP32 board or set up a Raspberry Pi with our SDKs, then connect Muse to your displays, buttons, sensors, actuators, and whatever else you've got lying on your workbench. … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Meta 开源了让开发者自制 Muse AI 硬件的代码与 SDK，用户可用 ESP32 或树莓派搭配显示屏、按钮、传感器，做出彩色墨水屏提醒器、HDMI 大屏终端或类 Muse Charm 的小型触屏设备。这是继 Muse 智能体后 Meta 在消费级 AI 硬件生态上的开放押注，意在把 AI 助手从手机 App 延伸到可自造的实体设备，与 OpenAI 的 Dots 形成正面竞争。

title: OpenAI’s Dot agent is enterprise software that can also order your dinner
raw_excerpt: New helpful little guy just dropped. | Photo: Allison Johnson / The Verge It's a tale as old as last week: OpenAI's new agent platform , called Dots, is full of cute little guys who can do your bidding. But unlike the ultra-approachable Meta Muse, Dots feel very much like using workplace software that happens to be able to order you a burrito - emphasis on work. OpenAI announced Dots earlier this week. Like Muse, Dots have blobby, anthropomorphic avatars and customizable names. In the future, OpenAI says you'll be able to have multiple Dots, but right now you get one. I named mine Dotty McDotface. The interface looks similar to Muse's; you chat with the agent in one window and follow its work in another as it  … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: The Verge 上手体验了 OpenAI 新推出的智能体平台 Dots：每个 Dot 有圆润拟人化头像和可自定义名字，目前每人只能拥有一个，未来将支持多个。作者认为它更像“恰好能帮你点墨西哥卷饼的办公软件”，工作属性远强于 Meta Muse 的亲和路线。这反映出 OpenAI 正把智能体定位为企业生产力入口，而非单纯的消费级玩具。

title: Microsoft's first streaming transcription model debuts at No. 1 on Artificial Analysis
raw_excerpt: Microsoft's MAI-Transcribe and MAI-Voice models provide accurate, fast, low-cost, and chart-topping audio understanding and generation. The company has launched MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming along with MAI‑Voice‑2.1 and MAI‑Voice‑2.1-Flash, giving users fast and fluid building blocks to create conversational experiences with no compromise on accuracy or voice quality. MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming delivers low-latency, real-time transcripts in 60 languages, all while supporting automatic, continuous language detection. MAI-Voice-2.1 supports 23 languages and 26 locales, allowing users to keep a single voice everywhere.
summary: 微软发布首个流式转录模型 MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming，在 Artificial Analysis 榜单登顶第一，支持 60 种语言的低延迟实时转录与自动连续语种检测；同时推出 MAI-Voice-2.1 与 Flash 版本，覆盖 23 种语言、26 个地区。这是微软自研音频基础模型的重要一步，为实时对话式 AI 提供低延迟、低成本、高准确率的语音底座。

title: AI music maker Suno now generates spoken words
raw_excerpt: Suno is branching out from the world of AI music, launching a new feature that generates spoken voices based on scripts or prompted descriptions. Speech is now available in public beta across Suno's web and mobile platforms, and allows you to simultaneously generate voiceovers and background music to accompany them. "Music will always be at the heart of Suno and what we build. At the same time, our vision has always extended to other forms of human expression," Suno chief product officer, Jack Brody, said in the announcement. summary: AI 音乐生成平台 Suno 推出语音生成功能，进入公开测试，覆盖网页与移动端，可根据脚本或提示词生成口播语音，并同时生成配套背景音乐。首席产品官 Jack Brody 表示音乐仍是核心，但愿景已延伸至其他人类表达形式。这意味着 Suno 正从纯音乐工具向“音频内容一站式生成”扩张，直接切入配音与播客市场。

title: arXiv最严新规！每人每月最多提交2篇，拒稿不退额度
summary: arXiv 出台史上最严投稿新规：每位作者每月最多提交 2 篇论文，且被拒稿也不退还额度，换分区提交同样无效。此举针对的是 LLM 普及后投稿量激增、审稿资源被挤兑的现状。对学术界而言，这将显著改变论文产出节奏与投稿策略，也可能间接抑制“AI 批量灌水”现象，是出版生态对生成式 AI 冲击的一次制度性回应。

title: 丘成桐新论文致谢了GPT和Claude
summary: 数学家丘成桐在新论文的致谢中提及使用了 GPT 和 Claude，该问题 44 年前曾被他本人列入问题清单。顶级数学家公开承认借助大模型开展研究，具有象征意义：它表明 LLM 已从编程辅助渗透到纯数学的猜想验证与推导环节。结合此前哈佛物理学家用 Claude 产出 36 篇论文的事件，AI 参与基础科研正从个案走向常态。

title: openJiuwen X-Router自演进模型路由技术首发，昇腾亲和，Agent越跑越省，实测减少50+%Token消耗
raw_excerpt: 让每一次请求选对模型，让每一次反馈都成为下一次更优、更省的选择
summary: openJiuwen 首发 X-Router 自演进模型路由技术，宣称对昇腾硬件亲和，能让 Agent 在运行中越跑越省，实测减少 50% 以上 Token 消耗。其核心思路是让每次请求自动选对模型，并把每次反馈转化为下一次更优、更省的选择。在推理成本成为 Agent 规模化瓶颈的当下，这类动态路由方案对国产算力生态的落地价值值得关注。

title: Open-sourcing AstaBrief, the fast report-generation model in Asta
summary: Allen AI 在 Hugging Face 上开源了 AstaBrief，这是其 Asta 平台中用于快速生成研究报告的模型。该模型面向科研场景，把检索到的文献与数据快速组织成结构化报告，是 Asta 科学智能体体系的关键组件。开源此举降低了科研机构自建文献综述与报告生成能力的门槛，也延续了 Allen AI 在开放科学模型上的一贯路线。
